sources.entry: Edison Mail - A customisable, simple, and beautiful email client. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Edison Mail
summary.one_liner: Edison Mail is a desktop email client for Mac that brings the mobile app's features to the desktop, aiming to unify multiple inboxes in one place.
keywords: email client alternative to apple mail
use_cases: Managing several email accounts in one app on a Mac
Using a private, ad-free email client
Bringing mobile email app features to a desktop
Blocking read receipts when sending or reading mail
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Edison Mail as a desktop email client for Mac that brings the features of its mobile app to the desktop. It says the app aims to unify all email accounts in one place and offers simple mailbox management plus an intelligent assistant that works behind the scenes. The page claims it is ad-free and says it blocks ad trackers and read receipts that would track emails. It also states the app is built for speed and a polished interface, though it gives no specific feature list.
notable: Ad-free with no ad-targeting trackers, and blocks read receipts
Unifies multiple email accounts in one app
Desktop version of the Edison Mail mobile app
Built-in intelligent assistant working behind the scenes
caveats: The page gives no details on paid tiers or what limits apply to the free version
Platform support is only stated for Mac; no other platforms are named
The page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete technical details
